newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU farm ministers expected to agree citrus regulation.
newsitem.headline: EU farm ministers expected to agree citrus regulation.

text.p: A regulation expected to be agreed on Monday on aid for citrus fruit poducers will represent a saving of about 20 million Ecus to the CAP budget, a European Union officicial said on Friday.

"Although there are still some problems to be ironed out by farm ministers on Monday there is broad agreement at official level for the latest Irish Presidency compromise paper," an Irish diplomat said.
Officials meeting the in EU's special agriculture committee have reached agreement on control measures to ensure that processing required under the regulation takes place.

"There is some disagreement about the size of penalties proposed at one percent for every one percent over quota. Some member states want the calculation based on a three-year average and others a 20 percent ceiling," the official said.
The item is the first on Monday's farm Council agenda and Irish officials say they expect an agreement.
